description: Get one meeting's agenda: the meeting itself, the scorecard snapshot (with each KPI's latest value), the rocks snapshot, OPEN issues (status open or in_progress) and OPEN to-dos, trimmed to the fields an agenda needs, plus counts of the closed and done items left out. Issues and to-dos are the organization's, not filtered to the meeting's team. Pass include_closed=true to also get recently resolved issues and done to-dos. Use to prep, render or summarize a meeting.

include_closed.description: Also return resolved/closed issues and done to-dos (the 100 most recent of each). Default false: open items only.

name: get_meeting_agenda
